note: Checked 75, filed 14 facts across 10 people, each parent-verified on its source page and read back in the Sheet exactly once. In-motion first: Sunday Wright Smith was installed as 2026-27 president of the Rotary Club of Potsdam at its June 3 annual dinner (Rotary Club of Potsdam; the same page carries her Midwife Sunday Wellness and Birth Center anchor). Alana Hoover was appointed Middle School Student Council Advisor at Thousand Islands Central School District for 2025-2026 (Oct 2025 board minutes; her blank Companies field was filled with the district) and advanced to M Step 2 effective June 2, 2025. Megan Phillips delivered the APA Planning Division report announcing the launch of a new public ArcGIS Hub platform (Aug 2026 minutes) and presented the Planning Division report at the Sep 2025 meeting where the board adopted the 2024-2025 Adirondack Park State Land Master Plan amendments. SUNY Canton honors filled the rest: Kayleigh Clary (President's List Fall 2025, listed as Kayleigh Peets, Health Care Management), Amber Erwin (President's List Spring 2024 and Part-Time Honors Fall 2025, both BSN), Erik LaMay (Dean's List Spring 2020 and Spring 2024), Nicholas Oddey (President's List Fall 2023, Criminal Investigation), and Kourtney Peets (Part-Time Honors Fall 2024, BSN — parent section-check corrected a batch claim that had her on the President's List). Also filed: Jesse Braun (Dean's List honoree as a Columbia College men's swimming and diving student-athlete, Academic Achievement Ceremony, May 2023) and Haddon Brown (Violin Society of America scholarship, 2019, while attending The Chicago School of Violin Making — his blank Universities field was filled with the school). Fresh sweep: none found — every in-window directory item was already on file (Michelle Johnston's Shaffer Award, Kwadwo Appiah-Kubi's tenure) or known-role only (Ben Hull background mention, Alisha Ohl and Samantha Marocco spokesperson quotes, Zvi Szafran quotes, routine Clarkson women's hockey goals). The hot list is empty: no filed fact was published Nov 2 or Nov 3. Two identity calls were genuinely ambiguous and were NOT filed: Bryan Noble — the DEC release lists a Bryan Noble of Canton among its Dec 2024 Environmental Conservation Police Officer graduates, an in-motion career start if his, but the source ties only the Canton/St. Lawrence County geographic cluster; and Kallie Belleau — a reported SUNY Canton BSN release could not be re-opened by the parent and a second researcher found no trace of her, so it sits in Research Command as a conflict candidate. This run added 26 candidates to the Research Command ledger, including Jess Evans's two gate-passing facts (Waddington hometown; Jake's on the Water server job) that lost the ten filing slots, the Bryan Noble and Kallie Belleau holds, an Emily Elliott NPI record two researchers read contradictorily, and sensitive family holds for Judson Colbert and Kale Hitchman. 0 JD console filings were reconciled into changes.json.
